desc:
Framer site changes and new sections cover the everyday work of keeping a site tidy and current, from spacing fixes to extra pages. Ecom Swift LLC edits your Framer project in a safe duplicate first, checks every screen size and publishes only when you approve.

## What are Framer design edits?

Framer design edits are targeted changes to an existing site: fixing layout and type problems, adding sections or pages, swapping images, correcting mobile layouts and updating visuals. They sit between a quick text change and a full redesign.

You give us a list, we do the work, and you get a note describing every change. The site keeps its identity. It simply stops showing the small flaws that make a site feel unfinished.

## Why small edits are worth doing properly

A list of small tweaks looks easy until you start. Changing a heading size on one page may break a layout on another. A new section copied from an old one may bring along stray spacing. A mobile fix may push content off the edge of a tablet screen.

Careful editing means checking each change at several widths, reusing existing styles instead of inventing new ones and leaving the project cleaner than it was found. Sloppy edits pile up into a project that nobody wants to touch, and every later change gets slower and riskier.

## How edits affect the way your site performs

Visitors judge a site quickly, and small flaws weigh on that judgment. Misaligned text, mismatched buttons and broken phone layouts suggest carelessness, which makes people hesitate to send a message or buy. Clean, consistent pages make the next step feel safe.

New sections and pages also do real work. A new service page gives search engines and visitors something specific to find. A fresh proof section answers doubts. An updated pricing block saves your team from repeating the same answers by message.

## What good Framer edits include

- A duplicate of your project, so edits happen away from the live site.
- Spacing, alignment and type fixes that use your existing styles.
- Mobile and tablet corrections at the real breakpoints.
- New sections or pages that match your visual language.
- Images swapped, resized and compressed.
- Buttons, links and anchors tested after each change.
- Reusable components in place of copied layers where it makes sense.
- Animation adjustments that stay smooth and subtle.
- A short style guide of colors, type and spacing, in larger packages.
- A written note listing everything touched.

## How we work

You send a list of changes, with screenshots or page addresses where possible. We confirm what fits the package and flag anything that looks bigger than it seems. Then we work in a duplicate of your project, so your live site stays untouched until you approve.

Basic covers a short list of small edits and mobile corrections. Standard adds more edits, a new page or a couple of new sections, image work and a check across three screen sizes. Premium covers a larger round, up to a few new pages or sections, reusable components made from repeated blocks, animation tweaks, a short style guide and a period of fixes afterward.

When you approve the preview, we publish and send the change note.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send edits as a numbered list with a screenshot for each.
- Say which pages matter most.
- Share any brand rules, such as exact colors or fonts.
- Review the preview on a phone as well as a laptop.
- Group related edits so they are done together.

**Avoid:**
- Sending requests in many small messages across several days.
- Editing the project yourself while we work on the duplicate.
- Asking for a full redesign inside a small-edit package.
- Approving changes without checking the mobile view.
- Adding new fonts or colors for every section.

## Who this is for

This service suits a business owner with a growing list of small site annoyances, a marketer who needs a new landing section before a campaign, and a team that inherited a Framer site built by someone else. It also suits anyone who wants a few new pages in the same style as the existing site.

We can work on a site that another designer built, as long as you can invite us to the project.

## What we need from you

Send your change list, the site address and any brand files or images for new sections. Invite us to the Framer project as a collaborator, so we work in your own account. We never ask for passwords.

If a change needs new text, tell us whether you will provide it or want to keep the existing wording.
